thread:
jamie: Proposal: 3-week Launch Sprint to test credit sizing + two onboarding nudges (tooltip vs inline walkthrough) and measure impact on day-3 and week-1 activation. Target lift 12-18%. Quick input? :sparkles:

maya: Good scope. Recommend n=150 seeded users (50 per arm). Credit arms: Small=30, Medium=60, Large=100. Nudges are orthogonal so we can randomize nudges within each credit arm.

nate: Creative: hero + 20s demo clip; CTA variants: "Try Starter Pack" vs "Join Live Booth". Need assets by Mon EOD. Also want a short social benchmark blurb: "See output in under 90s" for CTA.

leah: Office hours: schedule 3 regional sessions during week 1. Registration + calendar add on landing. Email cadence: welcome, 48h nudge, 24h before office hours, and post-webinar replay with credit reminder (expire in 7 days).

aj: Routing: utm=launch_sprint_5109. Tag by arm and nudge. Rule: if user >4 requests in 48h, mark as "engaged" and invite to office hours. I'll add tracking and attribution for A/B/nudge combo.

samir: Infra: pre-warm dedicated pool 25min before each session. Cap GPUs at 22 for peak, fallback to a quantized variant at 78% util. Enable prefix caching for starter templates and warm common KV keys. Set autoscale to min=2,max=22.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Autoscale updated for project/launch-sprint (min=2,max=22). Alert: p95 latency > 650ms -> page.

jamie: Measurement: primary = week1_activation (generation > 10 tokens + user-marked useful). Secondary = day3_activation, CPL, webinar conversion, time-to-first-success. Need dashboard with cohort breakdown (credits x nudge) and cost-per-activation.

maya: I'll mock the dashboard: cohort widgets, time-to-success heatmap, A/B/nudge delta cards. Will share link by Tue.

aj: Draft experiment config quick spec:

```json
{
  "experiment_id": "launch_sprint_5109",
  "n_total": 150,
  "credit_arms": {"small":30,"medium":60,"large":100},
  "nudge_types": ["tooltip","walkthrough"],
  "randomization": "stratified by arm",
  "engaged_threshold": 4,
  "metrics": ["day3_activation","week1_activation","cpl","webinar_attendance","time_to_first_success"]
}
```

leah: Email templates: will write short copy for each cadence, including replay + CTA to claim remaining credits. Also add a micro-survey after office hours to capture qualitative signal about templates.

nate: Creative timeline confirmed: drafts Mon, final assets Wed. Also prepping 30s cut for socials.

samir: I'll add pre-warm job and warmup script. Also configure fallback routing to quantized model variant at util threshold and ensure logging for any fallback events.

jamie: Action items: @aj implement tags + analytics hooks; @samir infra pre-warm + fallback + caching; @leah dashboard + email flows + micro-survey; @nate creative assets. Quick sync Fri 10:00 to review readiness and go/no-go. Thanks team! :tada:
